author: macro-strategist-cyrus-daruwalla
description: Gold-vs-equity 1-month momentum (goldbees_ret_1m - nifty500_ret_1m) as a leading risk-off scalar for the sizing layer. High trailing gold-outperformance -> cut exposure (flight-to-safety signal).
data: ALPHA_RANKER/rnd/panel/macro_state.parquet + datasets/etf_gold_silver/goldbees_daily_ext.parquet (fuller-coverage recompute, 125 obs vs macro_state's own 66-obs col)

test_1_linear_ic.note: Weak/unstable linear correlation with forward returns. Fails the lag-stability check (adding one extra month of staleness swings the IC), consistent with a NON-LINEAR / tail-driven relationship rather than a stable monotonic one.

test_2_exposure_scalar_backtest.method: expanding-window tercile scalar (0.5x/1.0x/1.5x exposure on nifty500 1M fwd return), orient=-1 (high gold-vs-equity momentum = risk-off, cut exposure)
test_2_exposure_scalar_backtest.verdict: CANDIDATE -- clears the random-scalar noise floor (z=2.34) and BEATS the incumbent India-VIX-alone scalar on both Sharpe (1.10 vs 0.82) and maxDD (-15% vs -24%).

conditions_for_graduation: Linear-IC gate FAILS (weak/unstable) but scalar-backtest shows real, noise-floor-beating improvement -- mixed evidence typical of a tail/regime-driven (not linear) signal. Route to overfit-analyst-sameer-bhat for era-split (pre/post-2020) + PBO check before any sizing-layer adoption. n=114 months is NOT enough for standalone certification.
